jobs.title: VP - Employee Workplace Solutions Management
jobs.description:
**Some careers open more doors than others.**


If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

**Business Descriptor**


Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6\.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day\-to\-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world\-class wealth management through best\-in\-class, mobile\-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.

 **Job description**

**In this role, the candidate will manage the following**

* To drive the strategy of IWPB Employee Banking Solutions for the allocated market
* To acquire, maintain relationships and increase product penetration within corporates by engaging with Key Influencers, by leading a team of 14\-15 Relationship Managers to drive EBS, Credit Cards, Personal Loans, Any time Credit and Top UP Medical Health Insurance ( BAGIC)
* To ensure that the quality of the corporates acquired are in line with the strategic focus of the Bank
* To ensure the team engages with existing EBS customers to increase penetration across various digital platforms (eg Mobile X \& PIB), IVR Card activations and salary credits.
* Drive open market business (Credit Cards, Personal Loans etc) through activities/deployments, promotions \& lead based calling.
* Develop a robust, diligent and compliant sales channel
* To liaise with product and support teams on a constant basis to enhance customer offerings and service delivery
* To adhere to all regulatory guidelines and handle complaints effectively.
* Deliver fair outcomes for our customers and ensure own conduct maintains the orderly and transparent operation of financial markets

 **Key activities to be driven**

* Work closely with both the GB/CMB RMs and MSF Business Development Managers (BDM) to engage with key decision makers of target corporates. Actively participate in presenting the HSBC EBS proposition with the objective to empanel them for the salary proposition
* Increase penetration of the corporates employee salary accounts with HSBC in the desired customer segments (Premier, personal Bankers)
* Make corporate work site marketing activities/deployments (WSMs) more interactive and effective
* Drive the overall asset strategy of WPB within the corporate space by identifying under penetrated opportunity segments, showcasing HSBCs offering and driving growth.
* Consistent delivery of the operating plan across all key products like EBS, Personal Banking accounts, PIL Cards, Premier Accounts)
* Controlling/lowering cost of acquisition within mandated cost guidelines
* Optimizing sourcing mix to focus on profitable segments in corporates
* Ensure minimal documentation errors (KYC) by driving the Right First Time behaviour across the team


We are currently seeking a passionate and experienced professional to join our team.

**Requirements**


To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

* University level education, preferably a MBA with 10 \-15 years of experience in banking.
* Front line sales experience is must in onboarding Salary Accounts, Personal Loans, Cards will be preferred.
* Good relationship management skills in order to engage effectively with both corporates and customers.
* Highly self\-motivated and self\-disciplined with the ability to work effectively and independently

 **Pro\-tip :** Familiarity with AI\-enabled tools is an advantage.

* *Mandatory to successfully complete Anti\-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post\-course assessment, as required.*

 *As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision\-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.*

  

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

  

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.


Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

The AI Product Manager will lead the definition, shaping, and execution of enterprise AI products and features for global clients. This role requires a rare mix of product judgment, AI fluency, consulting maturity, and hands\-on problem solving. You will work closely with clients, engineering teams, designers, and delivery leaders to identify opportunities, define product direction, manage expectations, and bring AI\-first solutions to life.


The ideal candidate understands how to apply GenAI and agentic patterns in enterprise contexts, is comfortable navigating ambiguity, and is hands\-on enough to prototype ideas, validate concepts quickly, and sharpen requirements through action. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II, FinTech
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Are you interested in building high\-performance, globally scalable Financial systems that support Amazon's current and future growth? Are you seeking an environment where you can drive innovation leveraging the scalability and innovation with Amazon's AWS cloud services? Do you have a passion for ensuring a positive customer experience? This is the job for you.  

  

Amazon's Finance Technology organization (FinTech) is responsible for building and maintaining the critical finance technology applications that enable new business growth, ensure compliance with financial and tax reporting obligations, and provide deep analysis of Amazon's financial data. This function is of paramount importance to the company, as it underpins Amazon's ability to effectively manage its finances and drive continued expansion.  

  

Amazon Financial Technology Team is looking for a results\-oriented, driven software development engineer, who can help us create the next generation of distributed, scalable financial systems. Our ideal candidate thrives in a fast\-paced environment, enjoys the challenge of highly complex business contexts that are typically being defined in real\-time. We need someone to design and develop services that facilitate global financial transactions worth billions (USD) annually.  

  

This is a unique opportunity to be part of a mission\-critical initiative with significant organizational visibility and impact.  

  

Design Foundational Greenfield Services: You will collaborate with your team to architect and implement the core services that will form the backbone of this new accounting software. Your technical expertise and innovative thinking will be instrumental in ensuring the foundational services are designed with scalability, reliability, and performance in mind for Amazon.  

  

Adopting Latest Technology: You will have the chance to work with the latest technologies, frameworks, and tools to build these foundational services. This includes leveraging advancements in areas such as cloud computing, distributed systems, data processing, and real\-time analytics.  

  

Solving High\-Scale Processing Challenges: This project will involve handling millions of transactions per day, presenting you with the unique challenge of designing and implementing robust, high\-performance solutions that can handle this scale of volume efficiently. You will be challenged to tackle complex problems related to data processing, queuing, and real\-time analytics.  

  

Cross\-Functional and Senior Engineer Collaboration: You will work closely with cross\-functional teams, including product managers, data engineers, and accountants. You will also be working directly with multiple Principal Engineers and presenting your work to Senior Principal Engineers. This experience will give you the opportunities and visibility to help build the required leadership skills to enhance your career.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Define high level and low level design for software solutions using the latest AWS technology in a large distributed environment.
* Take the lead on defining and implementing engineering best practices and using data to define and improve operational best practices.
* Help drive the architecture and technology choices for FinTech accounting products.
* Design, develop and deploy medium to large software solutions for Amazon accounting needs.
* Raise the bar on code quality, including security, readability, consistency, maintainability

  

About the team  

At the heart of FinTech's mission is the Financial Close Systems team, which builds and operates the technologies to support accurate internal and external financial reporting . The Close systems team provides capabilities to teams across FGBS orgs including Accounting, Finance, and Tax to effectively report the consolidated financials to external authorities. The work of the Close systems team is absolutely essential to meeting Amazon's critical month end close timelines and maintaining the integrity of the company's financial data.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Tax New
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------



Arcesium is a global financial technology firm that solves complex data\-driven challenges faced by some of the world’s most sophisticated financial institutions. We constantly innovate our platform and capabilities to meet tomorrow’s challenges, anticipate the risks our clients encounter, and design advanced solutions to help our clients achieve transformational business outcomes.


Financial technology is a high\-growth industry as change and innovation continue to disrupt the status\-quo and prompt major transformation. Arcesium is at a particularly interesting time in our own growth as we look to leverage our successfully established market position and expand operations in pursuit of strategic new business opportunities. We value intellectual curiosity, proactive ownership, and collaboration with colleagues, and we empower you to meaningfully contribute from day one and accelerate your professional development.


Arcesium is looking for a hands\-on Product Manager to own and drive the evolution of our Tax Product for the Alternative Investment industry. This is a builder’s role for someone who can work closely with Engineering to translate complex tax workflows into scalable technology solutions—from requirements definition through production delivery.



We are looking for someone who has personally built and shipped technology solutions for hedge fund tax operations. The ideal candidate will have demonstrated experience taking products or platform capabilities from concept and requirements through design, development, testing, and production, working closely with engineering teams throughout the process.



The role requires a strong combination of tax domain expertise, product thinking, and technology execution. You should be comfortable understanding complex hedge fund tax workflows, identifying opportunities to solve them through technology, defining clear product requirements, and partnering hands\-on with Engineering to deliver solutions that are scalable, reliable, and user focused.


**What You'll Do:**

  

* **Own the product**: Drive requirements, prioritization, and delivery for the Tax Product roadmap, working directly with engineering through the full lifecycle from problem definition to production.
* **Go deep on the technical detail**: Translate hedge fund tax mechanics like partnership allocations, wash sales, tax lot classification, K\-1 processing, and regulatory filings (FBAR, FATCA, FIN48\) into precise specifications.
* **Engage clients directly**: Handle client and internal stakeholder questions on tax product with the accuracy and timeliness the role demands.
* **Support the roadmap**: Contribute to and eventually own the vision and roadmap for the Tax Product that is informed by market trends and the needs of Alternative Investment clients.
* **Grow with the role**: This role starts as an individual contributor. Candidates who demonstrate strong independent delivery and domain command will have a path to leading the Tax Product team, earned through performance.


**What You'll Need:**


* 8–12 years of experience in US Taxation, with hands\-on domain expertise in US Tax Compliance and Planning for Hedge Funds.
* Working knowledge of wash sales, tax lot classification (including Section 1256 treatment), K\-1 and investor allocation processing, and regulatory filings such as FBAR, FATCA, and FIN48\.
* Direct, verifiable experience building or delivering technology solutions for tax operations like platform features, workflow automation, or systems you helped design and ship with an engineering team.
* Ability to work independently and produce accurate output that holds up on subsequent reviews.
* Strong communication skills, with a track record of meeting client and internal commitments on time.
* An outstanding academic background and genuine interest in working in a high\-tech software development environment.


Arcesium's Personal Data Privacy Notice for Candidates is linked here.

  

**Recruiting Security**  

Emails from genuine Arcesium recruiters who are employees of the company will always come from the @arcesium.com domain. In some cases, you may also be contacted by independent search firms engaged to recruit on our behalf; emails from their employees should always come from their firm's applicable domain. We'll never ask for your banking information or any payment as part of the recruiting process. If something seems off or you're contacted by an unexpected third party, please reach out to us at careers@arcesium.com (US/UK), careers\-india@arcesium.com (India) or careers\-europe@arcesium.com (Portugal/Sweden).


*Arcesium is an equal opportunity employer.*

jobs.description:
**Location:** Hyderabad, India (In\-Office)


**Target Markets:** India \& Australia


**Experience Level: 1\+ years**


**Reports To:** Marketing Manager / Founders


**About Us:**


At **Zithara.ai**, we are pioneering the next generation of **Customer Intelligence**. Our platform serves as the "North Star" for consumer brands, empowering them to unify disparate customer data, automate personalized omnichannel engagement, and deploy advanced AI Agents for sales, support, and marketing. Zithara.ai simplifies retention and accelerates revenue growth for high\-transaction, data\-rich industries across India and Australia.


**The Role:**


We are seeking a creative, data\-driven, and multi\-faceted **Social Media \& Omnichannel Marketing Executive** to join our growth marketing team in Hyderabad.


In this role, you won't just manage a single social page—you will own our brand’s digital footprint across organic social, paid advertising, and direct engagement channels like Email and WhatsApp. You will design, execute, and optimize cross\-channel campaigns aimed at capturing the attention of B2B retail business owners and C\-level executives in both India and Australia.


**Key Responsibilities:**


**1\. Social Media Marketing (Organic \& Paid Ads):**


* **Organic Strategy:** Plan, create, and schedule engaging content across LinkedIn, X (Twitter), YouTube, and Instagram that establishes Zithara.ai as a thought leader in Martech and AI.
* **Paid Campaigns:** Set up, monitor, and optimize paid ad campaigns on **LinkedIn Campaign Manager** and **Meta Ads Manager** to generate high\-quality demo requests and inbound leads.
* **A/B Testing:** Continuously test ad creatives, hooks, and audience segments (specifically targeting the Retail/E\-commerce landscape in IN and AU) to maximize ROAS and lower Cost Per Lead (CPL).

**2\. Omnichannel Execution (Email \& WhatsApp Marketing):**


* **Email Campaigns:** Build, segment, and execute targeted email marketing campaigns for inbound nurture tracks, cold outbound sequences, and monthly product newsletters.
* **WhatsApp Marketing:** Design and deploy conversational WhatsApp marketing workflows for event promotions (like trade shows), webinars, and direct lead re\-engagement.
* **Analytics Tracking:** Monitor key messaging metrics including open rates, click\-through rates (CTR), spam scores, and conversion rates to iterate on copy and targeting.

**3\. Content Creation \& Event Support:**


* **Copywriting:** Write compelling, persuasive copy for ad creatives, email subject lines, WhatsApp broadcasts, and long\-form social posts.
* **Collateral Coordination:** Collaborate with graphic designers or utilize tools like Canva to produce crisp, thumb\-stopping visual assets and video shorts.
* **Event Amplification:** Create buzz around major industry events and exhibitions (e.g., pre\-booking campaigns for retail trade shows) to drive foot traffic and booth appointments.

**Qualifications \& Requirements:**


* **Experience:** 2–4 years of proven marketing experience, ideally within a **B2B SaaS or Martech company**.
* **Paid Ads Mastery:** Hands\-on experience managing and scaling budgets on LinkedIn Ads and Meta Ads.
* **Tool Proficiency:** Experience using modern marketing tools (e.g., HubSpot, Mailchimp, Intercom, or native WhatsApp API setups). High proficiency with Canva or basic video editing apps is a major plus.
* **Exceptional Communication:** Stellar written and verbal English communication skills. You must be able to write sharp, professional copy that resonates with business leaders.
* **Data\-Driven Mindset:** You don't just post content; you actively track impressions, clicks, conversions, and revenue metrics to justify marketing spend.
* **Location \& Shift Awareness:** Based in Hyderabad. Willingness to occasionally align campaign scheduling and optimization tracking to match Australian business hours.

**What to Expect (Why Join Us):**


**"Drink Your Own Champagne"** \> You will be marketing a world\-class platform using the exact channels our platform automates. Your success stories will directly form the case studies we show our clients.


* **High\-Growth Environment:** Be part of an agile startup team where your ideas are implemented fast, and your impact is visible daily.
* **Advanced Tech Stack:** Work directly alongside AI engineers and SaaS growth experts, picking up cutting\-edge knowledge in AI agents and Customer Data Platforms (CDPs).
* **Competitive Compensation:** Attractive base salary with performance incentives tied directly to pipeline contribution and lead generation.

jobs.title: Community Manager
jobs.description:
**About the Role** 




 Scale.jobs helps job seekers across the US, Canada, UK, Germany, and Australia get their applications out the door. Hybrid AI \+ human, Techstars '24, profitable, millions of applications processed. Our own data says word of mouth is our biggest channel, and it has grown for 30 straight months without us doing a single deliberate thing about it. People land an offer and tell three friends. This role makes it deliberate. Turn that loose network into a real community that carries people through a brutal stretch of life, and that becomes our strongest acquisition channel as a side effect.
 



  





**What you'll actually be doing** 



* Picking the platform and building the space from zero \- Discord, WhatsApp, Slack, subreddit, whatever you can defend. Then getting the first 100 real members in and talking.
* Running the rituals that keep a community alive: office hours, AMAs with recruiters, resume teardowns, offer\-celebration threads, weekly job\-market roundups. Showing up consistently when nobody is watching yet.
* Finding and empowering the 20\-odd power users who will do more for the community than you can alone. Moderators, alumni who landed offers, people who just like helping.
* Turning member stories into content \- offer announcements, before/after resume threads, "here's exactly how I got the interview" posts \- and getting them in front of people who need to see them.
* Owning the referral loop end to end: when someone lands a job, they should have an obvious, easy, rewarding way to bring their friends in.
* Being the ear on the ground. You'll hear complaints about the product before support tickets do, and you'll bring them straight to us.
* Reporting on what's working with real numbers: active members, retention, referrals attributed, applications and revenue traced back to community.



  





**We'll vibe if you…** 



* Have built a community before and can show us the receipts. Numbers, screenshots, a link we can open. We care much more about "I grew this from 0 to 8,000 and here's what I did in month two" than about years of experience or where you worked.
* Genuinely believe community is a channel, not a cost centre, and can argue for it with data rather than vibes.
* Write well and quickly, in a voice that sounds like a person and not a brand account.
* Are comfortable being visible. This role involves your face and your name, not an anonymous admin login.
* Have real empathy for job seekers. A lot of our members are anxious, rejected, and running low on hope. If you can't sit with that, this will be the wrong job.
* Are fine with US and UK time\-zone overlap for events a few evenings a week.
* Move without being told what to do next. Nobody here will hand you a content calendar.



**Bonus, not required:** 
 you've been through an international job search yourself, or you've moderated a large forum, subreddit, or Discord.
 



  





**What's in it for you** 



* Full ownership of a function from day one, with a title and scope that grow as the community does.
* A profitable company. No runway anxiety, no "we're raising in six months, hang in there."
* Direct access to both founders. You'll pitch ideas to us in person and get an answer the same day, not three sprints later.
* A real budget for tools, events, community rewards, and creator partnerships.
* A product that measurably changes people's lives, which makes the community work much easier than it would be at most companies.
* Compensation matched to what you've actually built, plus performance upside tied to community\-attributed growth.



  





**Want to Fast\-Track Your Profile?** 




 Send your application to
 **hr@scale.jobs** 
 with the following:
 


1. **One community you built.** 
 A link, a screenshot, anything that proves it existed and grew.
2. **The numbers behind it.** 
 Where it started, where it got to, and what you did in month two that actually moved it.
3. **A short note on your first 90 days here.** 
 What you'd build, and in what order.



*No cover letter needed. We read every one of these.*

jobs.title: Oracle Fusion Finance Lead
jobs.description:
Azurity Pharmaceuticals is a privately held, specialty pharmaceutical company that focuses on innovative products that meet the needs of underserved patients. As an industry leader in providing unique, accessible, and high\-quality medications, Azurity leverages its integrated capabilities and vast partner network to continually expand its broad commercial product portfolio and robust late\-stage pipeline. The company's patient\-centric products span the cardiovascular, neurology, endocrinology, gastro\-intestinal, institutional, and orphan markets, and have benefited millions of patients. For more information, visit www.azurity.com.



Azurity Pharmaceuticals is proud to be an inclusive workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer. Azurity's success is attributable to our incredibly talented, dedicated team that focuses on benefiting the lives of patients by bringing the best science and commitment to quality into everything that we do. We seek highly motivated individuals with the dedication, integrity, and creative spirit needed to thrive in our organization.

**About the Role**



The Oracle Fusion Finance Lead will serve as the senior functional owner for Oracle Fusion Financials, accountable for the stability, governance, continuous improvement, and business effectiveness of finance processes across AP, GL, AR, Cash Management, Fixed Assets, BPM approvals, and related financial operations. This role is expected to provide hands\-on functional expertise while also leading stakeholder engagement, prioritization, solution design, controls alignment, and cross\-functional execution with Finance, IT, external partners, and business leadership.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Own the Oracle Fusion Financials operations for core finance modules, ensuring system stability, service quality, issue resolution discipline, and alignment with business priorities
* Lead functional configuration, solution design, governance, and controlled enhancements across AP, GL, AR, Cash Management, FA, approvals/BPM workflows, and related finance setups
* Provide senior functional leadership across Record\-to\-Report, Procure\-to\-Pay, Order\-to\-Cash, bank reconciliation, payment, invoicing, receivables, accounting, and period\-close processes
* Partner with Finance leadership and business stakeholders to define priorities, translate business needs into scalable Oracle Fusion solutions, and drive adoption of process improvements
* Oversee integrations, data corrections, reconciliation activities, reporting requirements, testing cycles, business validation, release readiness, and post\-deployment stabilization
* Establish strong documentation, controls, audit readiness, change governance, knowledge management, and continuous improvement practices for Oracle Fusion finance operations


**Required Skills and Experience**


* 10\+ years of overall Oracle ERP finance experience, with strong hands\-on experience in Oracle Fusion Financials
* Strong functional configuration experience in AP, GL, AR, Cash Management, FA, and BPM approval workflows
* Deep understanding of finance business processes including R2R, P2P, O2C, bank/cash management, accounting, payments, receipts, and financial close
* Experience in application support, configuration changes, enhancements, testing, UAT support, and post\-go\-live/steady\-state operations
* Exposure to integrations, OTBI/BI Publisher reporting, FBDI/ADFDI uploads, SLA/accounting rules, tax, intercompany, or fixed assets is preferred
* Strong problem\-solving, documentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills


**Preferred Qualifications**


* CA, CMA, MBA Finance, M.Com, B.Tech, or relevant postgraduate qualification
* Experience in post\-go\-live support / steady\-state Oracle Fusion finance operations
* Knowledge of finance controls, audit requirements, SOX\-oriented processes, and regulated business environments
* Experience in pharma, life sciences, or regulated environments is preferred
* Good\-to\-have exposure to Oracle EPM Cloud, including Planning, Budgeting, Forecasting, Financial Consolidation, Smart View, or finance reporting integrations between ERP and EPM.

  

By applying for this role, you confirm that you are mentally and physically capable of fulfilling the job responsibilities detailed in the job description without any restrictions. If you have any concerns or even the slightest disability that may affect your ability to perform the job, please inform HR in advance.

jobs.description:
**Job Description**
 The PO operates at the intersection of customer needs, business priorities, and team execution, bridging daily delivery decisions with the broader product vision defined by Product Management.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Act as the voice of the customer within the team, continuously exploring customer wants, needs, and preferences – whether customers are internal or external.
* Develop whole\-product thinking by understanding the full desired customer experience, not just individual features.
* Apply design thinking and Lean UX practices to identify the right problems to solve and guide solution design.
* Know the stakeholders – balance the needs of customers with the expectations of Business Owners, Product Management, System Architects, and other teams.
* Engage regularly with Product Management to understand market forces, business drivers, and evolving priorities.
* Represent the end user's perspective in roadmap discussions, validating that planned solutions deliver real value.
* Assist with program backlog prioritization by collaborating with Product Management, System Architects, and Project Managers on sequencing decisions.
* Communicate the vision and roadmap to the team during PI Planning, ensuring they have the context needed to execute effectively.
* Own the team backlog end\-to\-end – ensuring it is always populated with well\-defined, prioritized work ready for execution.
* Guide and review story creation, ensuring stories are clear, properly scoped, aligned to product strategy, and written with a user\-centric voice.
* Prioritize backlog items regularly using Cost of Delay (CoD) and value\-based frameworks to ensure the highest\-value work flows first.
* Accept completed stories by confirming they meet acceptance criteria, definition of done (DoD), and quality standards.
* Collaborate with System Architects to make space in the backlog for enablers and architectural runway.
* Provide daily product guidance to the team, elaborating stories, resolving questions, and managing emerging priorities during iteration execution.
* Balance feedback from customers, stakeholders, and internal data – maintaining a customer\-centric lens while respecting capacity and business trade\-offs.
* Foster built\-in quality by monitoring progress against acceptance criteria, NFRs, and the definition of done throughout the iteration.
* Actively participate in all team and program events: iteration planning, backlog refinement, iteration reviews, retrospectives, team syncs, and PI Planning.
* Test benefit assumptions by collaborating with Product Management to define expected value, then validating through customer and stakeholder feedback post\-delivery.
* Gather qualitative and quantitative feedback through empathy interviews, Gemba walks, iteration reviews, system demos, and application telemetry.
* Share feedback and insights across the program – with Product Management, System Architects, and fellow POs through PO Syncs and program events.
* Continuously evolve solution design by feeding insights back into the Plan\-Do\-Check\-Adjust cycle, driving relentless improvement of the team's output.
* Product Management owns product vision, market strategy, roadmap, and program backlog.
* The Product Owner translates that strategy into team\-level execution – owning the team backlog, defining stories, and guiding the team toward high\-value outcomes.
* Engineering designs, builds, and ships – with the PO as their daily product partner and customer proxy.


**Qualifications**
* 3–6 years of experience in product ownership, product management, or Agile delivery roles.
* Deep understanding of Agile practices – Scrum, Kanban – with a strong product mindset and customer\-centric orientation.
* Proven ability to write clear, well\-defined user stories and acceptance criteria using behavior\-driven development (BDD) principles.
* Experience prioritizing backlogs using value\-based frameworks such as Cost of Delay (CoD) or WSJF.
* Skilled at balancing multiple stakeholder perspectives while keeping the team focused on highest\-value outcomes.
* Strong communication skills – able to engage effectively with customers, engineering teams, and business leadership.
* Hands\-on experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, or similar for backlog management and delivery tracking.
* Familiarity with SAFe or scaled Agile frameworks is a strong advantage.


**Preferred**
* Experience participating in PI Planning, System Demos, and Inspect \& Adapt events.
* Understanding of Lean UX, design thinking, and human\-centered design practices.
* Familiarity with architectural concepts sufficient to support enabler story definition and runway planning.
* CSPO, SAFe PO/PM, or equivalent Agile certification.

We are looking for a highly analytical and result\-oriented Business Analyst who can analyse business decisions, troubleshoot issues, and communicate the findings effectively across different teams while raising the technical bar of the globally distributed analytics team, providing data wrangling expertise, deep understanding of data fundamentals, working with and synthesising very large datasets.  

  

We utilise multiple externally and internally (AWS and other) developed data platforms, including real\-time and close to real\-time platforms, to help create signal out of the mountains of data.  

  

Using LLMs will be critical requirement for this role as it needs experimentation and agent experience.
  

  

Our ideal analyst is one who enjoys discovering and solving complicated problems, can quickly learn complex systems, likes to work with numbers, and takes pride in organising and communicating his work.  Skills, Knowledge \& Expertise

* Experience working in Agile or hybrid delivery models

**Job Description**
**Job Purpose**
 ICE is seeking a Business Analyst to support the market surveillance technology used by its derivative exchanges. This is an exciting opportunity to join ICE and work within its exchanges business; the successful candidate will be a pivotal and noteworthy intermediary between business and technology and will have unrivaled transparency into the fundamentals of both domains.
   

  

 The individual will also be responsible for traditional business analyst activities, such as eliciting business and product requirements to then produce system requirements including functional specifications, use\-cases, and logical flow modeling. The Business Analyst’s role is vital in the creation and ongoing ownership of documentation for our Development and Quality Assurance teams to efficiently undertake their responsibilities; as such, the successful candidate will be expected to become a subject matter expert on market surveillance technology, assisting in all facets of the SDLC whilst interacting with and supporting end users.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Engage and work with stakeholders to understand their processes and requirements.
* Provide end users with product support to facilitate their daily activities and responsibilities; where necessary, prepare and provide training sessions and presentations.
* Work independently to create documentation and original content resource material, with a particular focus on Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Requirement Documents / Specifications (FRDs/FRSs).
* Extract and analyze data using several tools (ServiceNow, Excel, Python, Splunk, SQL, etc.)
* Gather data and perform analysis in a timely manner and verify the accuracy of results.
* Transform data analysis into information for broad audience consumption, including stakeholders .and senior management, leveraging appropriate visualization and presentation techniques to drive decisions.
* Assist Project Management with prioritization and tracking the implementation of system requirements.
* Assist Development and QA as a SME on market surveillance technology.
* Assist Product Management with roadmaps, initiatives, and vendor engagement.
* Assist Operations with incident management, resolution, and root cause analysis.
* Adhere to company cybersecurity and global policies; protect confidential customer information and the company’s intellectual property.
* Understand how the ICE markets, systems and technologies work.
* Occasionally assist in end user support activities (account administration, incident management and root cause analysis, and creating and maintaining business application / end user resources).
* Study new technology and remain technically current.


**Knowledge And Experience**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Business Development, Economics, Finance, Mathematics, or related discipline.
* Must possess excellent written and oral communication skills.
* Must be results\-oriented and self\-motivated.
* Must possess a good working knowledge of software testing and building high quality software.
* Must be proficient in the use of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Visio).
* Technical and functional business writing skills required.
* Detail\-oriented with demonstrated ability to write unambiguous requirements that do not imply design.
* Ability to effectively facilitate requirements gathering sessions, reviews and issue resolution involving multiple stakeholders.
* Demonstrates strong technical aptitude and understanding of how technologies impact delivery.
* Software product development, business analysis, quality assurance, or related experience highly preferable.
* Familiarity with Jira and Confluence preferable.

jobs.description:
**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human**  

  

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real\-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.  

  

This is an opportunity to do career\-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

### **Company Description**



Okta is the leading independent provider of enterprise identity. The Okta Identity Cloud enables organizations to securely connect the right people to the right technologies at the right time. With over 6,500 pre\-built integrations to applications and infrastructure providers, Okta customers can easily and securely use the best technologies for their business. Over 7,950 organizations, including 20th Century Fox, JetBlue, Nordstrom, Slack, Teach for America, and Twilio, trust Okta to help protect the identities of their workforces and customers.


### **Position Description**



We are seeking an experienced **Senior Software Engineer** to play a key role in building and scaling the **Okta Recovery Vault (ORV)**. This team is responsible for Okta's enterprise\-grade soft\-delete and object recovery capability, designed to protect critical identity objects (Users and Groups) from accidental or malicious deletion.



As a Senior Engineer, you will own the technical design, implementation, and operational reliability of critical components within our real\-time, high\-fidelity recovery system. You will solve complex engineering problems around identity preservation (UUIDs) and relationship restoration—including group memberships, app assignments, and password hashes—ensuring our customers can seamlessly recover from data loss events.


### **Job Duties and Responsibilities**


* **Feature Execution:** Drive the technical design and end\-to\-end implementation of complex features, such as granular and bulk recovery workflows across Free and Advanced Resilience tiers.
* **Component Design:** Design and build reliable core components for real\-time recovery systems that capture deletion events and support scalable data restoration.
* **Relationship \& State Management:** Solve challenging engineering problems around relationship restoration (group memberships, app assignments, device enrollments) and state consistency.
* **Security \& Compliance:** Implement secure logging and tracking for all recovery operations (soft\-delete, restore, permanent\-delete) in Syslog to adhere to strict audit and compliance standards.
* **Product \& Cross\-Functional Alignment:** Partner with Product Managers and technical leads to clarify requirements, define technical scope, and break down complex projects into actionable milestones.
* **Operational Excellence:** Participate in on\-call rotations, troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis (RCAs), and enhance system observability, logging, and metrics.
* **Code Quality \& Technical Standards:** Champion engineering best practices through thorough code reviews, automated testing, and comprehensive technical documentation.
* **Team Growth:** Provide guidance and peer mentorship to intermediate and junior engineers on the team to foster technical growth and code quality.

### **Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**


* **Experience:** 5\+ years of hands\-on software engineering experience building and scaling highly reliable, production\-grade applications.
* **Java Expertise:** Strong proficiency in object\-oriented programming, with extensive experience in **Java** and the **Spring Boot** framework.
* **Distributed Systems:** Solid experience with distributed system patterns, asynchronous job processing, and event\-driven architectures (essential for bulk restore operations).
* **Data Management:** Proficiency with relational databases (e.g., **MySQL**) and caching strategies (e.g., **Redis**) to manage state and high\-throughput data snapshots.
* **API Design:** Proven experience designing, building, and maintaining robust **RESTful APIs** for enterprise integration.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Are you passionate about building products that solve real customer problems at massive scale? As a Sr. Product Manager \- Identity at Amazon, you will own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for products that directly shape our abuse prevention and CX strategy by building robust customer identity solutions. You will work backward from customer needs, define compelling product strategies, and partner with engineering, design, and cross\-functional teams to deliver meaningful outcomes. This role offers the opportunity to tackle ambiguous problems, make high\-judgment decisions, and drive products from concept through launch and beyond — all while operating in an environment that rewards creative thinking and a bias toward experimentation.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Define product vision, strategy, and roadmap by working backward from customer needs, using a combination of customer research, market analysis, and data\-driven insights to prioritize investments and make smart trade\-offs.
* Partner with engineering, design, science, and cross\-functional teams to translate product strategy into well\-scoped deliverables, define acceptance criteria, and drive execution from prototype through launch and post\-launch optimization.
* Influence without authority across teams with different priorities, building alignment among stakeholders in engineering, marketing, sales, legal, finance, and operations to deliver cohesive customer experiences.
* Own product performance by defining success criteria and key metrics, analyzing usage data and customer behavior, and iterating rapidly to improve adoption, satisfaction, and business impact.
* Leverage generative AI tools and emerging technologies to accelerate development cycles, generate deeper insights, and identify new opportunities for product innovation.

  

A day in the life  

You start your morning reviewing product metrics and customer feedback, identifying signals that inform your next set of priorities. By mid\-morning, you are in a design review with your engineering and design partners, debating trade\-offs on a new feature. After lunch, you lead a cross\-functional alignment meeting to resolve dependencies with a partner team. Later, you draft a product narrative for an upcoming initiative, grounding your recommendations in customer research and data. Throughout it all, you balance strategic thinking with hands\-on execution.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**

* 5\+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
* Master's degree or equivalent
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with end to end product delivery

* Experience as a product manager or owner

* Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Technology is one of the most important parts of our business. Whether it’s supporting our songwriters, ensuring we provide the right royalty data to global partners, or helping our creative teams use the latest AI tools to discover new talent, technology plays an invaluable role in our success. Product Managers help turn vision into reality.
   

  

 We are looking for a Product Manager to partner with a local in\-person engineering team in Bengaluru focused on music distribution. Distribution is the vital link between music creation and a fan’s headphones, ensuring our music reaches platforms like Spotify and YouTube globally while protecting the complex rights that ensure our artists get paid. You will be a "user\-first" thinker who is responsible for a portfolio of features and products, navigating the high\-stakes world of global rights, supply chain automation, and high\-scale digital delivery.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Continuous Discovery: Build deep empathy for our labels, operations teams, and global partners by maintaining a constant dialogue with them. Uncover their underlying pain points, ensuring that every solution we build truly solves their problems and makes their daily workflows more seamless.
* Strategy \& Roadmap: Define and communicate the long\-term vision and roadmap for your products, ensuring they align with WMG’s broader tech strategy.
* Product Trio Collaboration: Work in a "Product Trio" alongside Engineering and Design to solve complex problems, resolving trade\-offs and tackling risks.
* Execution \& Ownership: Serve as the primary author of PRDs and the "executor\-in\-chief" for your projects, driving development from ideation through technical delivery.
* Launch \& Impact: Develop comprehensive go\-to\-market strategies, including product positioning, internal messaging, and launch plans. You don't just "ship" code; you ensure the organization is ready to adopt it to achieve maximum impact.
* Analytical Optimization: Continuously monitor product performance metrics, user feedback, and market trends. Use this data to make informed prioritization decisions, identify areas for improvement, and manage technical debt to optimize the product over its entire lifecycle.


**Who You Are**
* Experienced: You have at least 5 years of product management experience, ideally with exposure to the music business or other digital media.
* Technical \& Business Savvy: You can discuss system architecture with engineers and business constraints with executives, mitigating Value, Usability, Feasibility, and Business Viability risks upfront.
* A Master Storyteller: You own the "Why" and can easily adjust your communication style for different audiences, from developers to more senior stakeholders.
* Biased to Action: You have a proven ability to unstick a team, make difficult prioritization decisions, and navigate the ambiguity of a global business.
* Humble Leader: You have strong opinions, held weakly; you are quick to share credit with your team and accept responsibility when things don’t go as planned.
* Mission\-Driven: You are a music fan motivated by the fact that your work directly impacts an artist’s ability to grow their career and get paid.

**Product Manager : Consumer Experience** 




  





**We’re looking for a Product Manager who turns customer understanding into shipped outcomes.** 




 MyYogaTeacher helps people across the world improve their health and well being through live, personalized yoga. We connect students with experienced yoga teachers in India for 1\-on\-1 sessions designed around their goals, lifestyle, health conditions, and preferences.
 



 Our platform has served 200K\+ customers and supports thousands of live sessions across time zones, devices, payment systems, and customer journeys.
 



 We are now entering a phase where speed, clarity, and execution matter more than ever.
 



 We are looking for a hands\-on Product Manager who can speak with students, understand their real motivations, make sound decisions with incomplete information, and work closely with design, engineering, analytics, sales, and operations to ship meaningful improvements quickly.
 



 This is not a role for someone who only writes requirements, manages Jira, or waits for complete data before making a decision.
 



 You will be expected to understand the customer, form a point of view, bring teams together, and drive the product from problem discovery through execution and measurable impact.
 



  





**What You’ll Own** 




**Customer and Persona Understanding** 



* Develop a deep understanding of our students—their goals, anxieties, motivations, objections, habits, and reasons for choosing personalized yoga.
* Regularly speak with prospective students, active customers, churned customers, teachers, sales teams, and customer support teams.
* Convert customer conversations, behavioral data, support tickets, sales calls, and session feedback into clear product insights.
* Build and continuously refine customer personas and journey maps based on evidence rather than assumptions.
* Understand the underlying job the customer is hiring MyYogaTeacher to do—not merely the feature they are requesting.
* Ensure that product decisions remain connected to why MyYogaTeacher exists: helping people build healthier, happier, and more sustainable lives and identify ambivalence.



  





**Product Discovery and Decision Making** 



* Identify high impact opportunities across acquisition, trial, conversion, onboarding, engagement, retention, referrals, and reactivation.
* Clearly define the customer problem, target persona, expected behavior change, and desired business outcome before proposing a solution.
* Form strong product hypotheses using qualitative insights, product analytics, market understanding, and business context.
* Make thoughtful decisions even when information is incomplete or circumstances are changing.
* Distinguish between decisions that require deeper research and decisions that can be made quickly and reversed later.
* Maintain a clear product decision log so teams understand what was decided, why it was decided, and what assumptions are being tested.
* Challenge weak assumptions, unnecessary complexity, and solutions that do not address the underlying customer problem.



  





**Execution and Delivery** 



* Take end to end ownership of product initiatives from problem discovery to launch, adoption, measurement, and iteration.
* Translate product opportunities into clear requirements, user journeys, success metrics, edge cases, and acceptance criteria.
* Work closely with design and engineering to reduce ambiguity and unblock decisions quickly.
* Break large initiatives into smaller releases that allow the team to learn and deliver customer value sooner.
* Participate actively throughout development instead of handing over requirements and waiting for completion.
* Review product builds continuously, identify gaps early, and ensure that the final experience solves the intended problem.
* Drive weekly execution across multiple product initiatives while maintaining clarity on priorities and outcomes.
* Follow through after launch to measure adoption, identify friction, and improve the product based on actual customer behavior.



  





**Product Analytics and Business Impact** 



* Define measurable outcomes for every major product initiative.
* Use funnel analysis, cohort analysis, customer segmentation, experiment results, and qualitative feedback to understand product performance.
* Monitor key metrics across trial completion, trial\-to\-paid conversion, onboarding, session attendance, engagement, retention, referrals, and customer satisfaction.
* Investigate unexpected changes in customer behavior instead of relying only on dashboard\-level reporting.
* Partner with analytics and engineering teams to improve the quality and usefulness of product data.
* Communicate whether a product initiative worked, what was learned, and what should happen next.



  





**Cross\-Functional Leadership** 



* Bring together engineering, design, analytics, sales, marketing, teacher operations, and customer support around a shared understanding of the customer problem.
* Communicate product decisions clearly and directly across technical and non\-technical teams.
* Resolve ambiguity and disagreements by returning the discussion to customer evidence, strategic priorities, and expected outcomes.
* Conduct product demonstrations and training for teams responsible for launching, selling, supporting, or operating new experiences.
* Ensure that teams understand not only what is being built, but why it matters.
* Take accountability for the outcome without blaming dependencies, processes, or other functions when execution becomes difficult.

* Use AI tools as part of your daily product workflow—not as an occasional experiment.

jobs.description:
**About Us**
 Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life. We bring that vision to life through our values and culture. Learn more about Target here.
   

  

 Working at Target means the opportunity to help all families discover the joy of everyday life. Caring for our communities is woven into who we are, and we invest in the places we collectively live, work and play. We prioritize relationships, fuel and develop talent by creating growth opportunities, and succeed as one Target team. At our core, our purpose is ingrained in who we are, what we value, and how we work. It’s how we care, grow, and win together.
   

  

 Target’s distinctive brand love is infused throughout its many physical locations by the Properties teams. We have a direct and positive impact on the real estate, design, construction and maintenance of our 2000\+
 **stores, distribution centers and headquarters** 
 . Target invests 75% of annual capital investment into Properties, and over half of the enterprise OpEx, leading to significant opportunity to impact outcomes for the business. We have an ambitious goal to launch hundreds of new stores over the next 10 years, with several hundred more remodels in stores, all driving new customers and incremental sales for Target.
   

  

 Are you ready to help strategically grow Target’s brand through leading\-edge design, development, construction and preservation? Can you effectively balance the efficiencies of a large\-design build company with the unique challenges and innovative solutions required by individual sites? Then take your place as a Product Manager on Target Properties Product team and help us make the most of Target’s physical footprint both in the U.S. and overseas.
   

  

 Product Teams at Target Corporation are accountable for the delivery of business outcomes enabled through technology and analytic products that are easy to use, easily maintained and highly reliable. Product teams have one shared backlog that is inclusive of all product, technology and design work.
   

  

 As a Product Manager – GSCL Maintenance Operations, you will own the day\-to\-day product management for the work delivered in partnership with the Target in India Product Engineering team.
   

  

 This is a unique opportunity to help modernize Target’s Global Supply Chain Asset Management as part of a multi\-year transformation by moving from a highly customized legacy system to industry\-standard, out\-of\-the\-box Enterprise Asset Management capabilities for our Supply Chain Teams. The transformation will establish a more scalable and sustainable foundation for asset lifecycle visibility, standardized maintenance workflows, mobile execution, safety, workforce planning and scheduling, materials and inventory management, asset health, and predictive maintenance. This work will help reduce downtime, improve maintenance productivity, strengthen data quality and transparency, and enable better total\-cost\-of\-ownership decisions across Target’s supply chain network.
   

  

 Over the next several years, the team will establish the new Asset Management foundation and launch and scale across the network to eventually enable advanced asset\-health and predictive\-maintenance capabilities.
   

  

 As a Product Manager, you will work in the product model and will collaborate with your product team and key stakeholders to develop a plan and business objectives (OKRs) for your respective product. You will need to build a strong knowledge of your product through product discovery to collect customer feedback and work to collect other relevant data points that explain the value and help you prioritize the direction and desired outcomes for your product. You will work in unison with engineers, UX designers, data scientists and business partners to deliver a product.
   

  

 You will be the “voice of the product” with your product team and stakeholders to ensure that their needs are met, and you will be responsible to maintain and refine the product backlog (create user stories \& acceptance criteria) while prioritizing the backlog to focus on the highest impact work for your team and stakeholders.
   

  

 You will encourage the open exchange of information and viewpoints, as well as inspire others to achieve challenging goals and high standards of performance while committing to the organization's direction. You will foster sense of urgency to achieve goals and leverage resources to overcome unexpected obstacles.
   

  

 Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs.
   

  

**About You**
* Four\-year degree or equivalent experience
* 2\+ years of product management and/or equivalent domain experience
* Experience working in an agile environment (e.g. user stories, iterative development, scrum teams, sprints, personas, UI discovery and development)
* Strong facilitation skills that guide groups towards productive outcomes while maintaining a positive and collaborative atmosphere
* Demonstrated ability to bridge business and technical teams
* Curiosity with a passion for learning and contributing to a growth culture
* Product management experience in Asset Management/ Maintenance Management, or stores /properties experience preferred

 **strong technical foundation**

* You have
 **3\+ years of experience**

jobs.description:
**About SpotDraft**
 SpotDraft is on a mission to help legal and business teams move faster, together. Our AI\-powered contracting platform is redefining how companies manage contracts, and our story deserves to be told in creative, human, and memorable ways.
   

  

**Top Outcomes:**
 This role sits in the core workflow legal and business teams use every day to get a contract from draft to signature: collaborative editing and redlining, negotiating with counterparties, routing for approval, and signing. It’s one of the highest\-usage parts of the product, used by nearly every customer on nearly every contract, and it doesn’t have a single owner today.
   

  

 Scope is flexible and will be shaped around the person we hire, calibrated to their experience during the process rather than fixed in this posting. Part of the job either way is imposing a single prioritised roadmap on an area that today gets pulled in different directions by different stakeholders, rather than treating each piece in isolation.
   

  

**Day to Day:**
* Own discovery for your area. Run customer and prospect conversations every week, and turn what you learn into a clear view of who you're building for and why it matters to them.
* Make evidence\-based calls. Instrument what you ship, state your confidence level upfront, and track whether you were right so your judgment keeps improving.
* Partner through the build, not just at kickoff. Work with engineering and design end to end, and give everyone a release affects, support, sales, whoever’s downstream, a real briefing instead of a surprise.
* De\-risk before you build. Test your riskiest assumptions before you commit engineering time to them.
* Prioritise ruthlessly. Keep one ranked backlog sized against real customer demand, and be ready to defend the business case and trade\-off behind every roadmap call.
* Ship iteratively. Deliver a working increment every sprint, each one tied to a real outcome or a learning.


**What Success Looks Like**
* A clear, prioritised roadmap for the area you own, with an explicit plan for how scope grows from there.
* Measurable reduction in time and friction from “ready to negotiate” to “signed” within your area.
* Issues resolved through the product, not through a standing support escalation queue.


**Requirements:**
* Product management experience owning a feature or workflow end to end to a measurable outcome. Years of experience matter less than the scope you’ve handled: tell us what you’ve owned and we’ll calibrate the role to it.
* Comfortable working in a high\-usage, multi\-stakeholder area where prioritisation itself is a core skill, not just execution.
* Background in document collaboration, e\-signature, contract/legal tech, or workflow automation products is a strong plus.
* Comfortable ramping quickly in a legal or contract\-heavy domain if you don’t already have that background.


**Nice to have**
* Prior experience in a regulated domain where explainability/audit was a hard requirement rather than a nice\-to\-have.
* Exposure to agent\-action protocols (e.g., MCP) or policy\-engine design for agentic systems.


**Why SpotDraft?**
* Brilliant teammates—Work with some of the sharpest minds in legal tech.
* Expand your network—Interact with top founders, investors, and industry leaders.
* Real impact—Take ownership of projects and see your work in action.
* Big goals, bold moves—We trust you to deliver, innovate, and push boundaries.


**Our Core Values**
* Our business is to delight Customers
* Be Transparent. Be Direct
* Be Audacious
* Outcomes over everything else
* Elevate each other
* Be Passionate. Take Ownership.
* Be 1% better every day


**All candidates’ personal data shared during the recruitment process will be handled with utmost confidentiality and used solely for hiring purposes, in line with applicable data protection regulations.**
* SpotDraft is an equal\-opportunity employer. Candidates will not be discriminated against based on race, ethnicity, color, religion, caste, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, veteran, or disability status

 AI is becoming a core part of enterprise infrastructure, and many customers want reliable ways to run inference close to their data, systems, and operations. Windows Server has a solid opportunity to make that easier for organizations that already depend on Microsoft platforms.
   

  

 In this
 **Senior Product Manager** 
 role, you will help shape product experiences that simplify how customers configure, run, monitor, and manage AI inference on Windows Server. The work sits at the intersection of AI workloads, datacenter infrastructure, hardware acceleration, enterprise management, and customer trust. This is a high\-impact role for a PM who enjoys technical depth, customer empathy, and product building.
   

  

 Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day, we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Define customer scenarios, product requirements, and roadmap priorities for Windows Server AI inferencing experiences.
* Turn complex infrastructure workflows into simple, guided experiences for administrators and developers.
* Partner with engineering on configuration, deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management capabilities.
* Use customer feedback, telemetry, and field input to make clear product tradeoffs and ship focused improvements.
* Help the product work well across enterprise hardware environments, including GPU\-accelerated and CPU\-based scenarios.
* Build crisp product narratives, demos, documentation, and success measures that help customers and field teams understand the value.
* Collaborate across engineering, design, documentation, sales, hardware partners, and go\-to\-market teams.


**Qualifications**
**Required/Minimum Qualifications:**
* Bachelor's Degree AND 5\+ years experience in product/service/program management or software development.
+ OR equivalent experience.


**Other Requirements:** 
 Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:
   

  

* Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of product management experience shipping technical, platform, infrastructure, or enterprise products, or equivalent engineering\-to\-PM experience.
* Experience with AI inference platforms, products, services, or related AI infrastructure technologies.
* Solid technical judgment and ability to work credibly with engineers on systems, APIs, and infrastructure tradeoffs.
* Experience converting ambiguous customer needs into requirements, roadmap decisions, and shipped outcomes.
* Deep experience in AI/ML inference, model serving, developer platforms, distributed systems, datacenter infrastructure, cloud, edge, or on\-premises environments.
* Experience working with OEMs, silicon or accelerator providers, ISVs, systems integrators, or other ecosystem partners.
* Ability to drive cross\-functional execution across engineering, design, documentation, field, and go\-to\-market teams.
* Data\-informed product thinking using telemetry, customer feedback, and rapid iteration.

jobs.title: Sr Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About The Role**
 We are hiring a Sr. Data Product Manager to own a portfolio of Target Media data products end\-to\-end — from business definitions and contracts through datasets, pipelines, quality, governance, and delivery.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on role that works closely with Data Engineering, Analytics and Media Partners. You will partner with DE day\-to\-day to build and evolve datasets and pipelines across a medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) architecture, shape schemas and contracts, and make sure the data products that result are trusted and well\-governed. The core job is to translate technical capability into business outcomes. You will sit at the intersection of Roundel product, Data Engineering, MediaOps, and the broader Media Data Consumers.
   

  

**What You’ll Own**
 We are looking for a Sr. Product Manager — Measurement \& Analytics to lead the strategy, development, and evolution of data products that enable marketing measurement and attribution across Target Media.
   

  

**Measurement – Must Have**
 This role sits at the intersection of Product, Marketing Measurement, Analytics and Data Engineering. You will own products that help the organization understand the impact of marketing investments across channels, campaigns, audiences, and customer journeys.
   

  

 The initial focus will be on Roundel and Target marketing spend, with the opportunity to expand measurement capabilities across loyalty, promotions, and other enterprise marketing investments.
   

  

 A core responsibility will be building and scaling attribution and measurement capabilities that connect marketing exposure and spend to business outcomes, enabling stakeholders to understand what worked, why it worked, and where to invest next.
   

  

 Analytics \& Data Fluency — Must Have
   

  

 Strong Working Knowledge Of Analytics And Data Concepts, With The Ability To Partner Effectively With Analytics Teams. You Should Be Comfortable With
   

  

* Customer\-level and aggregated analytics
* Data aggregation and dimensional modelling
* Data pipelines and data transformations
* Data quality and reconciliation
* Metric definitions and semantic layers


 Building data products with Data Engineering
   

  

 You work hand\-in\-hand with Data Engineering to turn requirements into real datasets and pipelines — translating business needs into clear specs, prioritizing the backlog, and making trade\-off calls with DE on design and sequencing.
   

  

 Platform \& ecosystem stewardship
   

  

 Solid understand of Data Platform, cloud environment of GCP/BQ/PowerBI
   

  

 Trust, governance \& data quality — critical
   

  

 Data governance and data quality are central to this role, not an afterthought. As operational systems and automated workflows act on Roundel data, the cost of a stale or wrong data product rises sharply.
   

  

**What You’ll Bring**
* 10\+ years in product management, with meaningful time across Measurement, data products, data platforms, AdTech/MarTech, or retail media.
* Proven understanding Marketing Measurement concepts of Attribution, MTA, MMM, etc.
* Hands\-on experience working closely with Data Engineering to build datasets and pipelines — writing specs, shaping schemas and contracts, and prioritizing a technical backlog.
* Solid understanding of medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold) and modern data platforms (Lakehouse, data mesh, or federated architectures), including lineage and cost.
* Strong grasp of data governance and data quality — certification, monitoring, access, and consent — treated as critical, not optional.
* Track record of translating technical capability into measurable business outcomes and influencing cross\-functional partners without direct authority.
* Strong understand if PM Practices and working with Data Engineering, Analysts and Stakeholders.

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Company Description**
 At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content \- wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Gracenote's Data Platform is the central hub for millions of pieces of TV entertainment data used daily by clients and partners worldwide. It provides the critical services that structure and model data for our editorial, ingest, and delivery systems. This data powers entertainment solutions for the top cable, OTT, CE, and digital clients, reaching hundreds of millions of consumers.
   

  

 We are hiring a lead product manager to own this platform from our Bengaluru engineering center. The role also owns Gracenote's content\-source\-facing products, the Gracenote ID Distribution System (GNIDS) and Gracenote View, through which content owners register content, obtain Gracenote IDs, submit first\-party metadata, and access Gracenote data. This role has a deliberate arc.
   

  

 Initially, this is a hands\-on role. You will write specs and requirements yourself, work directly with engineers and data architects, analyze data with your own queries, and build deep fluency in the platform. We are looking for someone senior who still genuinely enjoys this work.
   

  

 As the platform and your fluency mature, the role expands into a player\-coach position, which will build and mentor a product team in India while remaining close to the platform. Candidates should be excited by both halves of this trajectory, not just the second one.
   

  

 You will be the lead product presence co\-located with our engineering organization, partnering across time zones with Dataset and Delivery Product Managers and commercial stakeholders based in the US and Europe. This is not a satellite role. It is the product anchor for our engineering center.
   

  

 An ideal candidate will have 8\+ years of Product Management experience and a proven track record of end\-to\-end ownership and delivering results.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own the product vision, roadmap, and delivery for Gracenote's Data Platform, the system that structures and models complex TV entertainment data for internal consumers and clients alike.
* Own the Gracenote ID Distribution System (GNIDS) and Gracenote View, including requirements, backlog, delivery, and support for existing customers and partner integrations. Define how these products evolve as the platform matures.
* Work closely with Global Dataset and Delivery Product Managers to understand the business problems in creating and structuring complex entertainment data, and translate those needs into a clear, prioritized roadmap.
* Partner directly with engineering teams and Data Architects to shape data models, write detailed requirements, and drive hands\-on execution, especially in the first phase of the role.
* Define and own the platform's key input and output metrics. Establish platform SLAs and quality measures, and publish them so internal and external consumers can hold the platform accountable.
* Operate effectively across a globally distributed organization: strong async written communication, disciplined documentation, and willingness to flex hours for overlap with US/EU stakeholders.
* Over time, hire, mentor, and grow a high\-performing product team in India while remaining an active individual contributor on the most complex platform problems.


**Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of product management experience, including 3\+ years on platform or data products.
* Demonstrated appetite for hands\-on IC work at a senior level: writing specs, querying data, working directly in the details with engineering.
* Actively uses LLMs in day\-to\-day product work: to accelerate analysis, drive better decisions, automate repetitive PM tasks, and achieve measurable outcomes. Be prepared to walk through concrete examples in the interview.


**Preferred Skills/Experience**
* Experience with TV/entertainment metadata, EPG data, content supply chains, or adjacent media data domains.
* Experience owning client\-facing web applications or APIs alongside a data platform.
* Experience partnering with Data Architects to shape complex business data into coherent, extensible, scalable structures.
* Prior experience as a hiring manager or formal people manager.
* Comfortable with XML, JSON, SQL, and REST APIs; able to write or LLM\-assist your own scripts in Python or SQL to answer product questions.
* Experience working within structured, milestone\-driven development processes and delivering predictably against commitments.
* Highly metrics\-driven: able to distill a complex platform into a small set of key input and output metrics and use them to drive decisions.
* Track record of driving execution rigor in collaboration with cross\-functional teams.
* Excellent verbal and written communication; proven ability to influence stakeholders across geographies and time zones.
* Interest and aptitude for people leadership: prior mentoring, coaching, or team\-lead experience, and genuine motivation to build a team as the role grows.
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.


**Additional Information**
 Please be aware that job\-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach …

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

Location: Bangalore

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

o Full Trade Lifecycle: Front\-to\-back from trade capture to settlement and accounting
  

* Expertise in SWIFT message standards: MT103, MT202, MT300, MT 320, MT 210, MT 292 and MX equivalents (ISO 20022\)

* Understanding of Accounting principles, trade booking logic, general ledger impacts, and NAV implications

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  

Preferred Qualifications
  

* Familiarity with tools such as JIRA, Visio, Excel (Advanced)

* Experience in leading Agile transformation initiatives is a plus

* Agile certifications: CSPO, CSM, SAFe Agilist, or similar preferred
**Why join us**
---------------

We are committed to creating a diverse environment and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status

Whether you’re joining us for a period of months, years or your entire career, together we can have a positive impact on the future. Creating, daring, innovating, and taking action are part of our DNA. If you too want to be directly involved, grow in a stimulating and caring environment, feel useful on a daily basis and develop or strengthen your expertise, you will feel right at home with us!


Still hesitating?
