Your remit includes the development of secure, scalable solution architectures, while ensuring integration across legacy on\-premise and AWS components where needed. You will collaborate with product owners, business analysts, delivery teams (including technical architects and developers) and external partners to convert business requirements into effective technical solutions. This includes evaluating solution options, estimating costs and ensuring that designs meet both functional and non\-functional requirements (e.g. security, performance, availability, scalability). Clear communication and stakeholder engagement are essential in this role.


**Key Responsibilities**

* Solution Architecture Design: Lead the design of end\-to\-end solutions on Azure (and advise on on\-premise or AWS where needed), selecting optimal services and patterns to meet both functional and non\-functional requirements. Produce architecture blueprints, dataflows and interface specifications.

jobs.description:

I further attest that all information I submit in my employment application is true to the best of my knowledge.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Principal Data Engineer**

**About the Role**


We are seeking a highly experienced **Principal Data Engineer** to lead the design, architecture, and implementation of enterprise\-scale data platforms that power Takeda's R\&D, Clinical, Regulatory, Commercial, and Enterprise Analytics ecosystems.


As a technical leader, you will drive the strategic direction of data engineering, define architecture standards, and deliver scalable, secure, and compliant data solutions using **Databricks, AWS, PySpark, Delta Lake, and modern DataOps practices**. You will partner with business stakeholders, solution architects, product owners, data scientists, and engineering teams to build reliable data products that accelerate innovation and data\-driven decision making across Takeda.


This role requires deep expertise in modern cloud data platforms, distributed data processing, software engineering practices, and cross\-functional leadership. You will mentor engineering teams, establish best practices, and ensure enterprise data solutions meet quality, scalability, security, and regulatory requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Data Architecture \& Platform Leadership**

* Lead architecture, design, and implementation of enterprise data platforms on Databricks and AWS.
* Define and govern enterprise data engineering standards, reference architectures, and reusable frameworks.
* Design scalable Lakehouse architectures using Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Databricks Workflows, and AWS cloud services.
* Collaborate with enterprise architects and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Drive platform modernization initiatives, cloud migration programs, and data transformation roadmaps.
* Establish best practices for data modeling, metadata management, data lineage, and governance.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend improvements to Takeda's data ecosystem.

**Data Engineering \& Solution Delivery**

* Design and build high\-performance batch and streaming (Optional) data pipelines using PySpark, Spark SQL, and Databricks.
* Architect ingestion frameworks supporting structured, semi\-structured, and unstructured data from internal and external systems.
* Lead implementation of medallion architecture patterns (Bronze, Silver, Gold) to support trusted enterprise data products.
* Optimize large\-scale data processing workloads to improve performance, reliability, and cost efficiency.
* Design and implement reusable ETL/ELT frameworks and accelerator components.
* Establish data contracts and engineering standards to ensure consistency and reliability across platforms.
* Ensure data solutions are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with enterprise architecture principles.

**Cloud Engineering \& AWS Platform Management**

* Architect and implement cloud\-native data solutions using AWS services including:
	+ S3
	+ IAM
	+ Glue
	+ Lambda
	+ ECS/EKS
	+ Step Functions
	+ EventBridge
	+ CloudWatch
	+ Secrets Manager
	+ KMS
	+ Redshift
* Design secure multi\-account architectures and governance models.
* Establish infrastructure automation practices using Terraform, CloudFormation, or AWS CDK.
* Drive optimization of cloud resources through cost management, workload tuning, and automation.
* Partner with cloud platform teams to ensure operational excellence and security compliance.

**DataOps, CI/CD \& Engineering Excellence**

* Lead adoption of software engineering best practices across data engineering teams.
* Design and implement CI/CD pipelines for data platforms using GitHub Actions, DevOps, GitLab CI, or Jenkins.
* Establish automated deployment frameworks across Development, Test, Validation, and Production environments.
* Implement unit testing, integration testing, regression testing, and automated quality gates.
* Drive code quality initiatives including:
	+ Peer reviews
	+ Static code analysis
	+ Test automation
	+ Release management
	+ Version control strategies
* Standardize engineering practices to improve delivery velocity and platform reliability.
* Promote Infrastructure as Code and automated environment provisioning.

As part of the Global SAP\-ERP Team, this IT role partners with Product Creation, Merchandising, Planning, Sourcing, Supply Chain, and Technology teams to ensure product and article data is complete, accurate, and ready to support end\-to\-end business processes.


This role serves as PVH's technical and functional expert for product and article data, including article structures, style\-color\-size relationships, GTIN management, product hierarchies, and enterprise data flows across SAP, PLM, MDM, PIM, and downstream applications. * Analyze recurring product and article data issues and drive root cause resolution.
* Develop documentation, validation procedures, and best practices for enterprise product data.
* Identify opportunities to automate product data validation and improve operational efficiency.
* Develop reporting and metrics to monitor product data quality and readiness across the enterprise.

* Product Hierarchies
* PLM, MDM \& PIM
* Data Quality \& Validation

You will work with cross\-functional teams to improve business performance, strengthen operational reliability, and support the day\-to\-day flow of Oracle Fusion OTC processes.


### **Role Overview**



As an OTC Functional Analyst, you will support and improve Order\-to\-Cash processes across areas such as order management, invoicing, receipts, customer master data, and month\-end activities. This role is well suited for a professional with 4\-6 years of experience who enjoys solving business problems, working closely with stakeholders, and turning functional requirements into effective system support and process improvements.

* Assist with issue resolution, root cause analysis, and post\-go\-live support for business\-critical processes.
* Support month\-end close activities for OTC\-related subledger processes, including reconciliation and documentation support.
* Partner with stakeholders to improve process reliability, data quality, and end\-user experience.
* Contribute to testing, validation, and change support for system updates and process changes.
* Document functional flows, business rules, and support activities clearly and consistently.

### **How You Will Do It**


* You will stay close to the business process, listen carefully to user needs, and remove friction where it affects customers or operations.
* You will own your work with accountability, accuracy, safety\-minded thinking, and integrity in every step.
* You will use a continuous\-improvement mindset, asking questions, challenging gaps, and helping the team solve problems early.
* You will collaborate openly across business and technology teams, building trust and aligning different perspectives toward one outcome.
* You will support structured issue handling, clear documentation, and disciplined follow\-through from analysis through resolution.
* You will contribute to reliable delivery by working methodically through testing, validation, and operational support activities.

### **Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.
* 4\-6 years of experience in an OTC functional analyst, business analyst, or similar role.
* Strong understanding of Order\-to\-Cash processes and their impact across the business.
* Experience supporting Oracle Fusion OTC processes, including order management, invoicing, receipts, or related finance activities.
* Ability to analyze business requirements, identify process gaps, and support functional solutions.
* Experience working with customer master data and month\-end close activities.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to work across business and technical teams.

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
Food Galery is a food and grocery delivery platform connecting customers, restaurants, stores, and delivery partners through a single digital ecosystem. We are looking for a Business Analyst to help us improve business operations, understand customer and restaurant behavior, and support data\-driven decision\-making.
   

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 1\. Business \& Operations Analysis
   

  

 \- Analyze Food Galery’s daily business operations and identify areas for improvement.
   

 \- Study orders, revenue, cancellations, refunds, delivery performance, and customer activity.
   

 \- Identify operational gaps and recommend practical solutions.
   

 \- Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly business performance reports.
   

 \- Monitor important business KPIs and highlight deviations.
   

  

 2\. Restaurant \& Merchant Analysis
   

  

 \- Analyze restaurant onboarding, order volume, revenue, ratings, cancellations, and performance.
   

 \- Identify high\-performing and underperforming restaurants.
   

 \- Track restaurant activation and retention.
   

 \- Provide insights to the restaurant onboarding and sales teams.
   

 \- Help identify opportunities to increase restaurant orders and revenue.
   

  

 3\. Customer Analysis
   

  

 \- Analyze customer acquisition, orders, repeat purchases, cancellations, and retention.
   

 \- Identify customer behavior and purchasing patterns.
   

 \- Analyze customer complaints and support data.
   

 \- Recommend strategies to improve customer satisfaction and retention.
   

  

 4\. Delivery \& Operations Analysis
   

  

 \- Monitor delivery times, order allocation, cancellations, failed deliveries, and delivery partner performance.
   

 \- Identify reasons for delivery delays and operational failures.
   

 \- Work with the operations team to improve delivery efficiency.
   

 \- Analyze performance by city, area, restaurant, and delivery partner.
   

  

 5\. Product \& App Analysis
   

  

 \- Work with the Product and Technology teams to identify business requirements.
   

 \- Understand problems faced by customers, restaurants, and delivery partners.
   

 \- Convert business requirements into clear functional requirements.
   

 \- Assist in developing and improving Food Galery app and website features.
   

 \- Participate in requirement gathering, testing, and feature validation.
   

 \- Identify opportunities to improve user experience.
   

  

 6\. Data \& Reporting
   

  

 \- Create dashboards and reports for management.
   

 \- Analyze business data using Excel, SQL, Power BI/Tableau or similar tools.
   

 \- Maintain accurate business reports and datasets.
   

 \- Track trends and provide actionable insights.
   

 \- Present findings to management and relevant departments.
   

  

 7\. Cross\-Functional Coordination
   

  

 \- Work closely with Sales, Restaurant Onboarding, KYC, Operations, Customer Support, Finance, Marketing, Product, and Technology teams.
   

 \- Coordinate with different teams to understand business problems.
   

 \- Follow up on improvement initiatives and measure their results.
   

 \- Communicate analytical findings clearly to both technical and non\-technical teams.
   

  

**Key KPIs to Monitor**
 \- Total Orders
   

 \- Gross Order Value / GMV
   

 \- Revenue
   

 \- Average Order Value (AOV)
   

 \- Customer Acquisition
   

 \- Customer Retention
   

 \- Repeat Order Rate
   

 \- Cancellation Rate
   

 \- Refund Rate
   

 \- Restaurant Activation Rate
   

 \- Restaurant Retention
   

 \- Delivery Time
   

 \- Order Success Rate
   

 \- Customer Complaints
   

 \- Delivery Partner Performance
   

 \- Marketing ROI
   

 \- Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
   

  

**Requirements**
 \- Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Economics, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related field.
   

  

 \- Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
   

  

 \- Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.
   

  

 \- Basic to intermediate knowledge of SQL is preferred.
   

  

 \- Knowledge of Power BI, Tableau, or other BI tools is an advantage.
   

  

 \- Understanding of KPIs, dashboards, business reporting, and data analysis.
   

  

 \- Good communication and presentation skills.
   

  

 \- Ability to work with multiple departments and manage priorities.
   

  

 \- Experience in food delivery, e\-commerce, logistics, fintech, or marketplace platforms is an advantage.
   

  

**Preferred Skills**
**Technical** 
 :
   

  

 \- Advanced Excel
   

 \- SQL
   

 \- Power BI / Tableau
   

 \- Data visualization
   

 \- Reporting \& dashboards
   

 \- Basic statistical analysis
   

  

  

  

 What You'll Do at Food Galery
   

  

 As a Business Analyst, you will play an important role in helping Food Galery understand what is happening in the business, why it is happening, and what we should do next.
   

  

 You will turn business and operational data into actionable insights that help Food Galery increase orders, improve restaurant performance, reduce cancellations, improve delivery efficiency, and create a better customer experience.
